tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark fades from bg-top down to bg over the first 900px; Titan is flat.

tokens.name: bg-top
tokens.usage: Top of the page gradient (Dark) and the sticky header strip.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels: cards, menus, palette, drawer, toasts. Dark runs card to card-2 as a vertical gradient.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fields inside a card: metric cells, code blocks, slot tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea ground. Dark: alias of card-2.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outline. Dark: 25% cyan; Titan: the panel joint.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, dividers, button and chip outlines, section rules.

tokens.name: fuge
tokens.usage: Titan's 1px panel joint around every plate, lamp ring and display window. Dark: alias of line.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of bars, meters and switches.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures, on bg, card and card-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, metadata, inactive nav, idle icons; on bg, card and card-2.

tokens.name: na
tokens.usage: The muted dash for a value the backend does not report; on card and card-2. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: acc
tokens.usage: Accent: active nav underline, focus ring (Dark), bar fills, primary button tint; the glow colour in Dark. Titan: signal-orange paint for fills and the primary button (white label), not for small text. Titan acc on card is 3.1:1: fills and 3:1 marks only.

tokens.name: acc-t
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links and 'more' links, on card. Dark: alias of acc. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Titan's signal orange: the 3px active-nav bar and the outer focus halo. Dark: alias of acc.

tokens.name: second
tokens.usage: Second hue: start of the context-bar gradient (second to acc).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Online, success, proxy on, 'fits' in the VRAM forecast; as text or icon on card. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Hints, slower than usual, VRAM short, aborted results; as text or icon on card. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors, crashed, context full (hot bar), danger buttons, recording; as text or icon on card.

tokens.name: b-llama
tokens.usage: Backend colour llama.cpp: card stripe, glyph plate, sparkline, model dot. Titan: lacquer paint with a white glyph.

tokens.name: b-ollama
tokens.usage: Backend colour Ollama.

tokens.name: b-lms
tokens.usage: Backend colour LM Studio. Titan: the lacquer is light, so the plate glyph misses 4.5:1 with white (kept as in the source; it is a 3:1 icon).

tokens.name: b-vllm
tokens.usage: Backend colour vLLM.

tokens.name: b-host
tokens.usage: Remote model host: the HOST plate (Titan, white text) and an idle host stripe. Dark: alias of muted.

tokens.name: st-idle
tokens.usage: State colour idle (dashed ring symbol).

tokens.name: st-read
tokens.usage: State colour reading the prompt (eye symbol). Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: st-gen
tokens.usage: State colour generating (pen symbol); the only state that breathes.

tokens.name: st-load
tokens.usage: State colour loading a model (clock symbol, spins). Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: st-off
tokens.usage: State colour offline (struck circle).

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Speed scale step 1, the slowest t/s in request and history rows.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Speed scale step 2. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Speed scale step 3. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Speed scale step 4, the fastest. Titan: 4.2–4.4:1 on card-2 (below AA for small text; source value kept), so set small text in it on card or bg.

tokens.name: l-gen
tokens.usage: Titan lamp fill, generating (white symbol inside). Dark: alias of st-gen. White on it is 4.0:1, fine for the 12px lamp symbol (3:1), not for text.

tokens.name: l-read
tokens.usage: Titan lamp fill, reading (white symbol). Dark: alias of st-read.

tokens.name: l-idle
tokens.usage: Titan lamp fill, idle (ink symbol). Dark: alias of st-idle.

tokens.name: l-warn
tokens.usage: Titan lamp fill, loading or warning (ink symbol); also the hazard-stripe yellow. Dark: alias of warn.

tokens.name: l-off
tokens.usage: Titan lamp fill, offline (white symbol). Dark: alias of st-off.

tokens.name: disp
tokens.usage: Titan display window: the dark glass behind tokens/s and the sparkline, the only place that glows in Titan. Dark: alias of card-2.

tokens.name: phos
tokens.usage: Phosphor green: figures and the sparkline inside a display window, on disp.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Amber: units, scale labels and missing values inside a display window, on disp.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Five steps replace the old ad-hoc 11/12/13/14/15/16/34px. Body is t-md at 1.45 with tabular digits everywhere.

styles.name: t-xl
styles.usage: The big tokens/s figure on a server card. Mono; glows in its backend colour (Dark) or phosphor in a display window (Titan).

styles.name: t-lg
styles.usage: Card titles, server and profile names, the palette input.

styles.name: t-md
styles.usage: Body text, table cells, nav links, notices, menu items.

styles.name: t-sm
styles.usage: Buttons, header stats, inputs, legends, secondary lines.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Uppercase labels sit above figures and on section rules.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section rule label (.sec), uppercase, followed by a hairline in line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Table headers, metric labels, meter labels; uppercase in muted.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Every measured value is mono with tabular digits so it does not jitter on the 2-second tick.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Meter values in the hardware card, profile t/s.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Metric cells, table numbers, model names.

styles.name: num-xs
styles.usage: Ages, durations, slot numbers, kbd hints.

groups.name: Titan plates
groups.note: Spacepunk Titan prints labels as stamped plates: mono capitals with wide tracking.

styles.name: plaque-sec
styles.usage: Titan section labels, in ink, with a fuge rule.

styles.name: plaque-title
styles.usage: Titan card and drawer titles, uppercase.

styles.name: plaque
styles.usage: Titan plates: PORT, HOST, SLOT, tags, badges.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between the monitor's two columns.

tokens.name: space-card-y
tokens.usage: Card padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: Card padding left and right (server cards 16px, Titan 18px to clear the stripe).

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page and header side gutter, also on phones.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the right column (hardware, profiles); stacks below 1020px.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of main.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, palette, notices in Dark. Titan sets it to 2px (hard plates) in bundle.css.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Metric grids, menus, toasts, popovers, empty states (Dark).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav links, header stats, slot tiles, the sparkline (Dark). Square-ish on purpose: a button is never a pill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, kbd. A status badge is never round, so it never reads as a button.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Titan plates, inputs, badges and display windows.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and the stop popover. Titan uses no soft shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: bar-glide
tokens.usage: Bar, slot fill and forecast width transitions: data-bound motion only.

tokens.name: halo-breathe
tokens.usage: Breathing halo on a busy server card (Dark only; off in html.shell and with reduced motion).
